thread:
maria-partnerops: Quick sync — we're locking the marketplace launch window for the joint listing with EdgeGrid and MosaicSI. Need checklist and owners for press, landing, legal, and integration test cutover. Can folks confirm owners and the blocker matrix?

jon-eng: I can own the integration test cutover with infra. Planning a staged rollout: sandbox -> staging -> listing. ETA for test harness: Thu EOD.

lina-marketing: I'll own press + blog draft. Need partner logos, hero quote, and final customer blurb from EdgeGrid by Wednesday. Also want a short animation for the landing hero — can we get assets? :sparkles:

vikram-hw: EdgeGrid will provide logos and one short quote. Hardware SKU/firmware compatibility doc is in our repo: https://git.internal/edgegrid/hw-compat. We'll share a sanitized snippet for marketing.

ashley-legal: Send embargo windows now. We need to review partner quote language and the joint announcement agreement. Found one gap in the logos CLA — adding that to the checklist.

sam-si: MosaicSI is good for the SI workshop demo on launch day. We need a stable API key for the staging listing so demos don't hit rate limits. Also will need a rollback play if the SI demo errors during live traffic.

maria-partnerops: Great. Drafting an ops playbook now. Current high-level timeline (WIP):
- Mon: final creative assets and quote approvals
- Tue: landing + listing copy deployed to staging
- Wed: press embargo sent to partners + legal signoff
- Thu: SI dry run + integration cutover to staging environment
- Fri: final smoke + go/no-go at 10:00 PT
Can everyone confirm feasibility?

erin-ops: +1, planning the smoke tests. Need exact endpoints and a short checklist for token scopes. Suggest adding a KV cache flush step pre-cutover.

jon-eng: OK for timeline. For cutover, here's the minimal rollout script we'll run in staging:```bash
# deploy listing version and warm KV cache
redwoodctl deploy --env staging --component marketplace-listing --version v2.1.0
redwoodctl warm-cache --path /v1/listings/edgegrid --workers 8
```
We'll also capture perf baselines before allowing demo traffic.

lina-marketing: Press angle: "Redwood + EdgeGrid + MosaicSI bring sub-100ms marketplace inference for edge workloads". I'll share the draft by EOD Monday. Also need a short case blurb — can EdgeGrid share 2-3 sentences about latency gains?

vikram-hw: Sending a 2-sentence blurb and logo variants (svg/png) to Lina in #assets. Also sharing SKU compatibility matrix.

ashley-legal: On embargo, proposed window: embargo lifts Fri 10:00 PT after our final smoke. Partners OK? If yes, I'll circulate the legal notice and the embargo list to press contacts.

maria-partnerops: Partners agreed in principle. @sam-si can you confirm the SI demo will be ready for a 9:30 PT rehearsal on Friday?

sam-si: Yes, 9:30 rehearsal works. We'll bring a fallback demo that uses smaller dataset if integration fails. Also opening a Jira for rollback steps: https://jira.redwood/browse/PROJ-4123

erin-ops: Two operational notes: 1) ensure the staging listing uses partner-scoped API keys (no prod keys), 2) we'll run a KV consistency check after warm-up. I added both to the playbook draft.

jon-eng: One technical blocker: quantized model variant for the marketplace listing currently has a slightly different tokenization mapping. Need to validate output parity for the demo prompts. I'll run evals against our canonical prompt set and post results to the thread.

maria-partnerops: OK—tag results with #quality-regressions. If parity delta > 0.5% we'll fallback to full-precision model for the demo.

lina-marketing: Creative ask: can we put the partner customer quote in a highlighted CTA on the landing? Also want a short FAQ for marketplace listing differences (dedicated vs hosted). I'll draft the FAQ and paste into staging copy.

vikram-hw: FYI EdgeGrid legal requested we remove any specific firmware version numbers from public copy until GA. We'll provide a compatibility doc link with a small note instead.

ashley-legal: Noted. Also need to approve the partner badge SVG for the listing. I'll sign off once the assets are uploaded.

maria-partnerops: Upload checklist (WIP):
- assets (logos, hero, quote): lina/edgegrid -> done?
- landing copy + FAQ: lina -> draft by Mon EOD
- legal embargo notice + CLA: ashley -> sent Tue AM
- SI demo keys + rollback play: sam -> staging keys by Thu
- integration test harness + parity evals: jon -> Thu morning
- ops smoke tests + KV flush: erin -> Fri 8:30 PT
- go/no-go decision: maria + partners -> Fri 10:00 PT

jon-eng: Posted parity evals: small delta on unusual tokens, overall P95 latency meets target. I'll push a patch to normalization config tomorrow.

erin-ops: Ops readylist updated and linked in the playbook. Also added a temporary monitoring dashboard widget for partner listing traffic.

sam-si: SI rehearsal scheduled on calendar for Fri 9:30 PT, invite sent to partners + ops.

lina-marketing: Draft press release in Google Docs: https://docs.google.com/edgegrid-launch-draft. Comments welcome.

ashley-legal: I've uploaded the embargo notice and the partner badge change request to the legal drive. Please review.

maria-partnerops: Thanks all — last ask: please react with :white_check_mark: when you’ve completed your assigned preflight item. I’ll lock the launch lane once all are checked.

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: Fri 09:00-11:30 PT. Auto-rollback enabled at failure threshold 5%.

jon-eng: :white_check_mark: parity evals posted, patch queued.

erin-ops: :white_check_mark: smoke checklist in playbook.

lina-marketing: :white_check_mark: draft press + landing copy uploaded.

sam-si: :white_check_mark: staging keys provisioned.

vikram-hw: :white_check_mark: assets in #assets and logo CLA accepted.

maria-partnerops: Nice — with that, we're green to proceed to final rehearsals. I’ll post the final playbook link and the announcement timeline after legal sends the embargo notice. Thanks team! :tada:
